title: tests/access/expectations.yaml: the hand-written access expectations (A9)
description: Frozen in phase 001. Written by hand and reviewed by the owner, never generated from the rules they test (ARCHITECTURE-V2 4.6). make access-verify runs every row; k2gen check refuses a policy, a base table or a denied layer that no row covers (S07). Part of the document set (k2gen.model.DOCUMENT_ROOTS), so the coverage check reads it. Each row is one of five shapes, told apart by its keys: a table read, a table denial, a statement, a network probe, a drift check.

principal.description: The principal the row runs as.

relation.description: <catalog>.<namespace>.<table>, optionally a $ metadata table such as t$files.

via.description: The endpoints the row runs through; REST joins in phase 003.

tableRead.description: The principal reads the table and sees exactly these columns, with these masked, rows at least this old, never a row matching mustNotAppear, and the rows mustAppear names.

table.description: A reader name; never a base.

visible.description: Every column SELECT * returns, in any order.

masked.description: Columns that must read as null in every row.

minRowAgeMinutes.description: The newest visible row is at least this old, by the table's delay column.

mustNotAppear.description: A SQL predicate on the table that must match no visible row.

mustAppear.description: The positive half: at least minRows visible rows (1 when absent), each matching the SQL predicate where when it is given, so a table that built no rows fails the row instead of passing every negative assertion. Known rows by id are a where such as `id IN (1, 2, 4)` with minRows their count. k2gen check requires one on some read row of every role with a policy (S07).

minRows.description: How many visible rows, at least.

where.description: A SQL predicate on the table those rows match.

tableDenied.description: Every read of the table by the principal is refused.

table.description: Any relation: a base, a bronze table, a foreign view, a $ table.

statement.description: One SQL statement run as the principal, and how it must end.

session.description: Session properties sent with the statement as X-Trino-Session headers (the CLI's --session), not by SET SESSION: the header form of a property denial (gate h1.24).

expect.description: denied: an access denial; error: any other query error (a numeric version on a view); noBounds: SHOW STATS returns no low or high value.

probe.description: A network connection that must be refused, or open.
Where the connection starts and what it dials.

from.description: The host, a container on a network (k2-net, k2-catalog), or a one-shot container (fetch, tools).

expect.description: refused: no TCP connection; open: one is made.

drift.description: The catalog drift check (ADR-061 condition 5): reader-namespace listings, view SQL and trino.run-as-owner equal the release.
What is compared with the release.
